cut_cutover_checklist_item.usage: read authorized applicable item projection for export

cut_cutover_checklist_item_result.usage: read only the authorized current selected result for export

cut_task.usage: read task/project/frozen configuration identity and authoritative current stage

export.auditOwner: PlatformCommandExecution/operation audit without changing CUT aggregate version
forbiddenData: fields absent from the authorized detail projection

navigation.evaluationPoint: after all existing checklist submit guards and business writes succeed; returned only when that transaction commits
navigation.stateIsolation: the decision cannot insert/update cut_task, stage history, checklist or result rows

dependencies.F-CUT-001: configuration revision lifecycle and existing navigation_rule_snapshot carrier
dependencies.F-CUT-003: checklist facts, authorized detail projection and submit state transition
dependencies.PLT: not used for export artifacts; existing checklist evidence references remain governed by F-CUT-003

controlledPositiveLoop: CUT tests may assemble a deterministic PROJ scope substitute to prove export and post-submit navigation orchestration; production Owner facts and real browser completion remain separate gates
